title: main moved is lost under the board's concurrency group
status: open; the owner's choice of fix (DESIGN.md, 14)

steps.note: the merge fires its four events at once: a push to main, the pull request closed, the issue closed and the head deleted; one run starts and one waits
the delete's run starts first and tells nothing, since as built main moved is keyed on the event that started the run; reading the spec, any run tells a pull request behind main
the pull request's run replaced the push's, which waited, so #100, behind main now, is never told as built; reading the spec, it is owed the word
